Grepping the whole scripts/ tree for `drift-gate-expectations` finds exactly one hit outside the plan itself: scripts/record-drift-gate-result.mjs's sample_count derivation, which reads `.defects.length` for a fallback value and never validates label correctness or an exact count of 10 -- and its own test, record-drift-gate-result.test.mjs:111-117 ('sample_count is derived from the real expectations ledger'), only asserts the incidental byproduct (sample_count===10 today), not the AC's actual requirement ('exactly those ten entries with a valid label on each'). AC-A2 needs either a NEW_TEST_REQUIRED node:test asserting the ledger's shape/labels/count, or a corrected EXISTING_TEST_COVERS citation naming an actually-persistent, actually-re-run test.

AC-A2 (PRD AC-12) row revised from EXISTING_TEST_COVERS to NEW_TEST_REQUIRED, naming scripts/validate/checks/drift-gate-expectations-ledger.test.mjs (verified present at that path and picked up by the scripts/validate/**/*.test.mjs glob used by both node --test and npm run validate's native-validate check).
